# webbpulse_run_role_check (Data Source)

Reports whether the runner has assumed one workspace's run role. It calls `GET /workspaces/{id}/run-role/check`, which reads the runner's own record and records nothing, so plans and refreshes never change the workspace. The API never calls STS: the answer is the outcome of the runner's AssumeRole in the newest run made with the current role, and a role no run has tried yet is `unverified`. A plan-only run is the check. A workspace with no run role at all is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "webbpulse_run_role_check" "example" {
  workspace_id          = webbpulse_workspace.example.workspace_id
  fail_if_not_connected = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace whose run role is checked.

### Optional

- `fail_if_not_connected` (Boolean) Whether any `status` other than `connected` fails the read. Defaults to `false`, which reports the outcome as data instead. An `unverified` role fails too, because no run has proven it yet.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The account the role resolved to, or null unless `status` is `connected`.
- `checked_at` (String) When that run tried the role, or null when `unverified`.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether `status` is `connected`.
- `error` (String) Why the runner could not assume the role, as one sentence, or null. A role that does not answer is not an error here unless `fail_if_not_connected` is set: the trust policy may simply not be in place yet, so the plan succeeds and shows the reason in this attribute.
- `run_id` (String) The run whose AssumeRole this outcome comes from, or null when `unverified`.
- `status` (String) `connected` when the runner assumed the current role, `failed` when it tried and was refused, or `unverified` when no plan has run on this role yet.
